proofBoundary: Machine-verified experimental options; runtime, player-surface, semantic, save/load, and support proof remain separate.

options.name: Above All Else
options.description: Darbalag's Lovecraft-inspired descent. Hermaeus Mora answers the pursuit of forbidden knowledge to its end.

options.name: Baba Yaga and the Labyrinth
options.description: Mara approves of rescuing the witch from the Black Stone Labyrinth.

options.name: Bark and Bite
options.description: Freeing the three werewolf spirits pleases Hircine; sparing Frija instead pleases Stendarr and disappoints him. Sheogorath is amused either way.

options.name: Before the End
options.description: Mara and Arkay approve of staying with the condemned man Aradell until the end.

options.name: Beyond Skyrim - Bruma
options.description: Data-only channels for eight direct Bruma resolutions: smuggling, treacherous murder or generous song restoration, freeing Bjarni, and recovering stolen antiquities.

options.name: Calling the Watchmaker
options.description: Data-only channel for the explicit cold-murder branch.

options.name: DAc0da
options.description: Data-only reactions for the two directly evidenced DAc0da resolutions.

options.name: Depths of the Soul
options.description: Zenithar approves of helping the merchant Pike open his shop.

options.name: Glenmoril
options.description: Data-only reactions for the directly evidenced Glenmoril resolutions.

options.name: Hunt for the Spectre
options.description: Data-only channel for the directly evidenced Spectre defeat.

options.name: Moonpath to Elsweyr
options.description: Data-only channels for the Tenmar journey, Thalmor rebellion, saved/released plague branches, and completed rebel base.

options.name: Olenveld
options.description: Data-only reaction for the directly evidenced Olenveld resolution.

options.name: Once We Were Here
options.description: Hoping the Falmer may yet be redeemed pleases Auri-El, their forebears' god; calling the damage irreparable disappoints him. Includes an ESL-flagged plugin.
options.dependency: Once We Were Here - Quest Mod.esp

options.name: Siege at Icemoth
options.description: Data-only channels for ending the necromancer's undead army and uncovering the Font of Memory.

options.name: Sirenroot
options.description: Lays the haunting Ayleid spirit to rest: Arkay, Meridia, Stendarr, Tu'whacca, Azura, Y'ffre, plus the elven pantheon (Auri-El, Xarxes, Magnus) for the Ayleid dead, and Zenithar for honest salvage work.

options.name: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers
options.description: Data-only reaction for the directly evidenced Saints and Seducers resolution.
options.dependency: Skyrim Extended Cut - Saints and Seducers.esp

options.name: Taste of Death Addon
options.description: Data-only channel for bringing Markarth's Namira cult to justice.

options.name: The Forgotten City
options.description: Data-only reactions for the directly evidenced Forgotten City resolutions.

options.name: The Frozen Heart
options.description: The cursed woman is a Snow Elf, so Auri-El reacts most of all: curing her is a milestone in his eyes, killing her a grave offence. Mara, Stendarr, Trinimac and Molag Bal also weigh in.

options.name: The Gift of Saturalia
options.description: Five data-only channels for the separately resolved Saturalia gifts; the umbrella completion is excluded to prevent double credit.

options.name: The Rot Below
options.description: Namira is named in the quest itself. Foiling her plan angers her and pleases the death-and-light gods; killing or sparing the freed lich Adabelle splits Mara and Dibella.

options.name: Unslaad
options.description: Data-only reactions for four directly evidenced Unslaad outcomes.

options.name: Vigilant
options.description: Data-only reactions for the directly evidenced Vigilant outcomes.

options.name: War's Folly
options.description: Adds Devotion reactions to all six stances you can take with Sandor the preacher, from pride in slaughter to renouncing the war. Includes an ESL-flagged plugin (also repairs two dialogue endings that never set their quest stage).

options.name: Whispers of the Depths
options.description: Mara approves of offering condolences to the old sailor. Includes an ESL-flagged plugin.

options.name: Wyrmstooth
options.description: Data-only channel for defeating Vulthurkrah while defending Stonehollow.

options.name: College of Winterhold - Quest Expansion
options.description: Data-only channels for seven directly resolving College lessons. The umbrella curriculum completion is excluded to prevent double credit.

options.name: Ebony Blade Curse
options.description: Data-only reaction for breaking the Ebony Blade curse.

options.name: Forsworn Conspiracy - Quest Expansion
options.description: Data-only channels for the trial-by-combat resolution and the separate Madanach mercy route.

options.name: Ill Met by Moonlight - Dialogue Expansion
options.description: Hircine answers returning the totem to the hunt. This is the addon's own added quest; vanilla DA05 stays owned by core Devotion.

options.name: Infiltration - Quest Expansion
options.description: Data-only channel for restoring Treva's Watch to Stalleo and his family.

options.name: Nilheim - Misc Quest Expansion
options.description: Data-only channels for defeating Telrav's double-cross or explicitly extorting him.

options.name: Paarthurnax - Quest Expansion
options.description: Data-only objective-derived channel for persuading the Blades and sparing Paarthurnax. Organic traversal is mandatory.

options.name: Save the Icerunner
options.description: Data-only channels for stopping, persuading, joining, betraying, or lawfully exposing Jaree-Ra's Icerunner wrecking plot.

options.name: The Heart of Dibella - Quest Expansion
options.description: Dibella and Mara answer carrying the temple's letter for the sisters. This is the expansion's own added quest; vanilla T01 stays owned by core Devotion.
options.dependency: The Heart Of Dibella - Quest Expansion.esp

options.name: The Whispering Door - Quest Expansion
options.description: Data-only channel for disposing of Mephala's Ebony Blade so it can cause no further harm.

options.name: Thieves Guild Alternative Endings
options.description: Self-contained data channel plus generic quest-stage adapter that separates TG09's three endings without replacing Devotion scripts. Vanilla return remains stage 200; freeing the Nightingales and keeping the Skeleton Key route to synthetic stages 201/202 and suppress false Nocturnal commitment.

options.name: M'rissi's Tails of Troubles
options.description: Data-only channels for the proved enslavement, marriage, and kinship outcomes. Unproved chapter routes remain excluded.

options.name: Song of the Green - Auri
options.description: Data-only channel for Auri's five-grove pilgrimage through Skyrim's beautiful natural sites.

options.name: Thogra
options.description: Data-only blood-oath, betrayal, and two marriage-route channels. The objective-derived Largashbur marriage must be traversed organically.

options.name: Xelzaz
options.description: Data-only channels for crimson Nirnroot research and the proved recipe/spice theft plus mead tasting. Ambiguous routes remain excluded.

options.name: Bards Reborn - Student of Song
options.description: Dibella answers the discipline of the Bards College: completing the course of study, and taking up the bard's road after induction.

options.name: Become a Bard
options.description: Dibella answers performance itself - playing for a tavern, and playing before a Jarl's court.

options.name: Aetherium Forge Destroys Items
options.description: Installs an ESL-flagged observer quest for successful artifact destruction. Existing saves are baselined without retroactive awards.

options.name: Daedric Shrines AIO prayer activators
options.description: Installs a neutral ESL-flagged prayer-activator plugin and BOS swaps for eleven supported Daedric Shrines AIO statues.

options.name: Legacy of the Dragonborn
options.description: Data-only channels for the Trial of Trinimac, ending the Eye of Camlorn's curse, and bringing peace to a Snow Elf ghost. Composite Ezra branches and linear relic fetches are deliberately excluded.
